verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is explicitly designed for self-hosting: it can be built from source or run via pre-built binaries/Docker, serves models locally via `llama serve` with a built-in web UI, and runs on diverse hardware (CPU, Apple Silicon, NVIDIA/AMD/Moore Threads GPUs) with no external dependencies. Community reports corroborate real-world self-hosted usage across Mac, Linux, and various hardware configs. Missing for 10: no first-party managed/hosted cloud offering comparison or enterprise self-host deployment guide beyond Docker/binaries.
